videos.headline: Austin Alexander returns a blocked FG for a Kansas TD
Jamal Roberts finds the end zone on a 64-yard run for Mizzou

Isaiah Marshall makes an amazing throw falling out of bounds for Kansas
Mizzou defense forces a fumble on 4th down
